checkpoint.title: Fly to Celadon City, wake Route 16's Snorlax with the POKE FLUTE and run from it

events.why: from below Mr. Fuji (10.06) down and out of his house's door (4, 7) onto Lavender Town below its door (10, 11), where Fly works
the Pidgey (Fly, 10.01) flies to Celadon City, landing below the Pokemon Center's door (48, 11); pokeguy flies there from Mr. Fuji's at 1:11:30
on the BICYCLE with SELECT (registered in 08.03)

west across Celadon and out onto Route 16's east end (Celadon's row 23 is the route's row 13), along row 13 to face the Snorlax (31, 13), which with the walls at (29..31, 12) and (29..31, 14) closes the way west
Route16_EventScript_Snorlax: with FLAG_GOT_POKE_FLUTE, "Want to use the POKE FLUTE?"
YES: the flute plays, the Snorlax wakes and attacks (setwildbattle SPECIES_SNORLAX, 30; dowildbattle)

Snorlax Lv30, a wild battle; RUN as pokeguy does (1:11:57; user's call: no RNG, no catch). B_OUTCOME_RAN goes on to "SNORLAX calmed down... returned to the mountains" (Route16_EventScript_FoughtSnorlax), and FLAG_HIDE_ROUTE_16_SNORLAX keeps it away

checkpoint: From Mr. Fuji's house (10.06), PokeGuy's way (1:11:24 to 1:12:00): Fly to Celadon, bike out onto Route 16 and wake the Snorlax (31, 13) with the POKE FLUTE (Route16 map.json, scripts.inc). He runs from it (Lv30, base Speed 30: the lead outspeeds it, so RUN gets away on the first try). The Snorlax stands on a hidden LEFTOVERS (FLAG_HIDDEN_ITEM_ROUTE16_LEFTOVERS), which pokeguy leaves.

The checkpoint stops on the tile east of the Snorlax's, saved there: west of it the planner's maps still have the Snorlax (its hide flag is set by the flute's script, not by the story's map flags), and Cycling Road (Route 17) has no map in the runtime maps yet, and Route 16's west part has six Bikers (sight 1, LOOK_AROUND) on both sides of rows 12..14. With the BICYCLE (FLAG_GOT_BICYCLE) the gate's no-pedestrians triggers are off (VAR_TEMP_1 1).
The save is on Route 16, ROUTE 16 on the save card.
